verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents facet search explicitly used to power autocomplete/type-ahead interfaces, and it tracks search queries/clicks/conversions via analytics, but there is no documented feature that generates suggestions from aggregated real search traffic (e.g., popular/trending query suggestions) or a dedicated suggestions-index API — developers would need to build that layer themselves on top of facet search + analytics data. Missing for 10: a first-party query-suggestion/autocomplete-from-traffic feature or documented pattern for building one, and any independent evidence of it being used this way in production.
